title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Computer Science - Spreadsheets
subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which application is best suited for calculations and tabulating data?
questions.explain: MS Excel is a spreadsheet application designed for data organization and calculation.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: In a spreadsheet, the intersection of a Row and a Column is called a:
questions.explain: The individual box in a spreadsheet where data is entered is called a Cell (e.g., A1).
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Every formula in MS Excel must begin with which symbol?
questions.explain: Excel recognizes a cell entry as a formula only if it starts with the equals sign (=).
questions.subject: Computer Science
